decisions.reason: Fouling detection automation builds on the firm's established automation and wastewater/energy-recovery know-how, and its own R&D and university and EU research cooperation give it the absorptive capacity to interpret early results and improve the product.
A web tool for weir dimensioning draws directly on the firm's flood-control engineering expertise and standardized IT modules, so it is cheap to maintain and fits its digital service portal strategy.
The fouling detection system complements Product A and the firm's heat-recovery direction, and its related knowledge and research activities let it learn from early deployments.
